summary: Saints (1-4) are without LT Banks, RB Etienne and LBs Elliss and Jennings and rank 30th against the run; the healthier Giants are 4-1 ATS. Most likely to win: New York Giants +1.5.

legs.note: ESPN's 46.5 is a point above most books' 45.5, and the Saints offense is stalling (81.8 rush ypg).

extra_legs.note: Most likely leg to win: the Saints' patched line faces a healthier Giants team that is 3-0 ATS at home.
Near a coin flip by price, while models such as Squawka (66%) and numberFire (53.7%) favor New York.
The Saints allow 148.8 rush ypg (30th) and are missing LB Elliss and edge Jennings.

research:
Searches: 19 web searches (2 hit the shared search cap). WebFetch failed with DNS errors on every site, so all findings come from search-result snippets.
1. QBs and personnel: NYG QB Jaxson Dart (2026: 26/34, 250 yds, 3 TD, 0 INT) is on IR, possibly for the season, after a knee injury vs the Rams (NFL.com). Jameis Winston has started since then: 76/132 (57.6%), 805 yds, 6 TD / 3 INT, 81.2 rating and a PFF grade of 59.0 (26th of 34). In the Week 5 tie with WAS he went 33/54 for 326 yds and 3 TD (NFL.com, PFF). NO QB Tyler Shough (2nd year): 137/205 (66.8%), 1,299 yds, 9 TD / 5 INT, PFF 74.6 (12th of 34), but only 16/25 for 96 yds and 2 INT in a 23-13 Week 5 loss to MIN (Statz, Rotowire). Chris Olave has 39 catches and 537 yds (2nd in the NFL), with 182 in Week 1 and 100+ in 3 of 5 games. Isaiah Likely and Malik Nabers lead the NYG targets.
2. Injuries (Friday, BigBlueView/Saints.com/AtoZ): NYG LT Andrew Thomas, RT Jermaine Eluemunor and OLB Abdul Carter were DNP Wed-Thu but practiced fully Friday, and Harbaugh expects all three to play. NYG are OUT CB Colton Hood (concussion), S Tyler Nubin (neck) and TE Theo Johnson (neck). S Pinnock cleared protocol. Brian Burns, Robertson-Harris and Golston are on IR (NBC). NO: LB Kaden Elliss (calf) and edge Anfernee Jennings (knee) are OUT. WR Olave (illness, limited Friday), RB Alvin Kamara (back, limited all week), DT Shepherd and CB Styles are questionable. LT Kelvin Banks (ankle surgery) and RB Travis Etienne (hamstring, IR) are out. No inactives list was found before publishing.
3. Advanced stats: Sources differ on NO offense, with EPA/play ranked 18th-29th (-0.05), success rate 16th-31st, and its last 2 games 25th/27th. NO rushes for 81.8 ypg, and ESPN says the offense is 'declining each week'. NYG defense is 20th-22nd in EPA allowed (+0.04) for the season but 4th in EPA and 10th in success rate over the last 3 weeks (Sharp/BettingPros). Pressure: NYG is last at 25.8% (one source) but hit Daniels 5 times in Week 5. NO blitzes 31.8% (9th) but pressures only 18.2% (29th). Shough has been pressured on 45.1% of dropbacks since Banks went down (27th). The NO defense is near the bottom in points allowed and efficiency (Covers).
4. Scheme: The key matchup is the NYG rush (Carter back) against NO's backup LT, with TE and RB chip help expected. NO's low pressure rate should give Winston time, which helps NYG passing volume. NYG's run game has struggled, with Skattebo fumbles (SI mailbag).
5. Coaching: John Harbaugh (NYG, 1st year) is 3-1-1 SU and 4-1 ATS, 3-0 ATS at home, and 3-0 SU at home in one-score games (Covers, SI). Kellen Moore (NO, 2nd year) is under fire for the offense, and NO is 2-3 ATS.
6. Situational: NFC non-division game at 1 PM ET with no major travel factor. NO has lost 3 straight, and Gayle Benson's public remarks and practice visit add pressure (BigBlueView 5 questions). Winston faces his former team. NO plays in Paris against PIT next week, a possible lookahead spot.
7. History: Series tied 17-17. NO has won the last 3 meetings (24-6 in 2023, 14-11 at MetLife in 2024, 26-14 in 2025) and the last 2 at MetLife. The Audacy/WWL 27-17 NO pick leans on this.
8. Weather: Mid-50s, about 8 mph wind, no rain (Covers). Neutral.
9. Experts and market: NYG side: Covers (Geoff Clark, NYG ML; early lean NYG +1.5 and Over 45.5, Kalshi 55% NYG cover), Sportsbook Review (NYG ML -104, 25-23), The Collector Nation (NYG +1.5, 27-20), Squawka model (NYG 66%, 26-20), numberFire (NYG 53.7%), Pick Dawgz (NYG). NO side: SI (NO 27-23), Fox computer (NO 25-23, over lean), Audacy/WWL (NO 27-17). Yahoo and BigBlueView staff are split. Totals: VegasInsider headline calls it 'surprisingly high-scoring', and SI, Fox and Covers lean over. Lines: opened NYG -1.5 to -2.5, flipped to NO -1.5 (Predictem, WagerTalk, VI consensus NO -1.5), with some books at a pick (BetRivers NO 0). Moneyline NO -105 to -110, NYG -106 to +104. Total 45.5 at most books (dipped to 44.5) and 46.5 at Circa; VI consensus o46.5 -105. Early money on Oct 11 was all NO, then NYG drew 100% of money on Oct 12 (WagerTalk). Props: Olave rec yds 79.5 (FanDuel o-114, BetRivers u-114) to 80.5 (SI). Winston pass yds 220.5-225.5 at DK (no price found, so not used; Collector projects 260). Rotowire's pick is Likely o51.5 rec yds -114 FanDuel (not used because no per-game projection was gathered). Team totals were not found because the search cap was reached, so no team-total leg is offered.

That is 231 yds per start, very volatile (sd about 85). He threw 111 yds in relief at LAR. Winston pass yds props seen at DK 211.5 (-111) and FD 208.5 (-114) on ScoresAndOdds, but the date was unclear, so not used.

- Skattebo: 81 carries, 294 yds (58.8/g); only one game over 60 since Week 1. Line o58.5 rush yds: -111 DK (Rotowire pick), -109 ESPN pick, Lineups 58.5 opener; BettingPros has 56.5. NO run D allows 148.8 rush ypg (30th, Fox), 4.86 ypc (26th, SI) and 10 rush TDs (most in the NFL), plus a league-high 133.4 ypg to RBs (FlurrySports), with Elliss and Jennings out.
